cli: Claude Code 2.1.317 and 2.1.321 (interactive sessions, as the CLI wrote them)
recording: one long real interactive session (about 17,000 rows), read only; the fixture holds 40 rows of it
sanitization: built by sampling rows by type, never by copying the file: one row of each bookkeeping type the parser ignores (custom-title, agent-name, pr-link, mode, bridge-session, relocated, atis-latch, last-prompt, tools-used, file-history-delta, api-request-shape, cost-state, queue-operation), one coherent turn of 22 conversation rows, one user row and three queued_command attachments whose origin is human, task-notification and peer
bookkeeping rows keep their field names and the timestamp only: every string is the placeholder [text], every number 0, every nested value dropped; the session id is a fixed placeholder

conversation rows went through the storage whitelist (store_filter.stored_row), which drops account identifiers, request bodies, working directories and branches, and then every text, thinking block, tool input string and tool result became a placeholder naming only its length; a task notification keeps its task-id, tool-use-id and status tags and a placeholder summary
the fields the parser reads are unchanged: types, uuids, timestamps, message ids, models, stop reasons, usage, tool use and result ids, origin kind, source_uuid, promptId
